question.text: What is the minimum application size per application in an SME issue?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.233, the minimum application size in an SME issue is one lakh rupees per application. The Trap: Rs. 10,000, Rs. 50,000 and Rs. 2 lakh do not match the prescribed SME minimum application size in the source. Note: Applications in an SME issue are invited in multiples of the minimum application amount of Rs. 1 lakh.
